name: Hex Beam
description: The Hex Beam is a compact directional HF antenna that uses a six‑arm spreader system to support a pair of wire elements shaped into a broad hexagon. It provides excellent gain, front‑to‑back ratio, and multiband capability in a lightweight structure.
modelingNotes: Driven element perimeter sets resonant frequency.
Spreader length controls the geometry of the wire layout.
Mutual coupling between wires shapes the radiation pattern.
Height above ground influences takeoff angle and gain.
Hexagonal geometry provides compact size with beam-like performance.
